The **Exchange** option gets you the correct pair soonest — it ships a replacement Size 9 in **2 days**, which fits your 3-day event deadline. (Refund takes 3–5 days and doesn't get you shoes at all; Store Credit is immediate but also doesn't directly get you the shoes.)

Since a return of the Size 8 pair is required for the exchange, you'd send those back with the included prepaid label after receiving the new pair.

Want me to go ahead and select the Exchange option?
